title: Mutated
description: A mod that adds a total of 7 new mobs that are the results of 2 fused vanilla mobs
body:
# This mod was made for a sake of a youtube video (linked at the bottom)

It adds a total of 7 new mobs :

## The zillager

![zillager](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3448f9f598e0386b7b70ef41c41d95257594b4db.png)

Fusion of the blaze and the villager, it is a rare occurence that spawns in the nether. Right clicking the mob with a blaze rod or blaze powder will make you "trade with him" Trading with blaze rods has a chance to give you an eye of ender. Trading with blaze powder can give you ender pearls

## The zombified squid

![zombified squid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/148b75ab4f4052ffface4807c6c11b2db5ccfdf7.png)

Fusion of the zombie and the squid. It is a hostile mob that will spawn in water

## The sheeb

![sheeb](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0991d1acd435c03c72f9be394200d4c4c4b309ff.png)

Fusion of the sheep and the bee, right clicking it with a bottle gives you a honey bottle. You can shear it to obtain bee wool, but it will make the mob angry and attack you. With that bee wool you can make yourself a bee helmet. A useless helmet, but it looks cool so who cares ? Hitting the sheeb will anger it.

## The wandering fox

![Wandering fox](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7305cebe561cead539e8a01379f713f023767d87.png)

Fusion of the fox and the wandering trader. This mobs is not fundamentally hostile, but it will run todwards the player, steal the item in his main hand, and disapear.

## The santaur

![santaur](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c339f3b9b570991e11841f68f3090e9ce74adf4c.png)

Fusion of a vindicator and a horse. It's exactly the same as a vindicator but he runs faster.

## The elder spider

![elder spider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92eb15b9bf2b7a6845434667ffa80f26eb5b874b.png)

Fusion of the spider and the elder guardian. This spider deals throns damage when you hit it, and shoots cobwebs at you.

## The levivex

![levivex](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03d0a56258876a4517856521d212a64f58b29735.png)

Fusion of the shulker and the vex, this mob spawns in the end and is neutral. It will deal massive damage to any entity with the levitation potion effect
